highlights.title: Overview
highlights.value: Salem University in Salem, West Virginia, is a private, career-focused university with a 100‑acre campus. It’s an ideal choice for you if you’re looking for associate, bachelor’s, master’s, and certificate programmes.

highlights.title: Student life
highlights.value: Salem University offers a warm and friendly environment. You can join over a dozen clubs at the university, including Biology, Criminal Justice, International Student Organisation, and Tiger Techies.

highlights.title: Accommodation
highlights.value:
Salem University offers you on-campus housing, which is double rooms. These rooms come with furnishings, Wi‑Fi, laundry facilities, and access to lounges and recreation spaces.

Additionally, if you’re looking for budget-friendly accommodation options outside the campus, feel free to download our app and check out the Stays feature!

highlights.title: Facilities
highlights.value:
Library
On campus, you’ll find the Benedum Library, which houses all the study resources you need, along wth a lot of study spaces.

Sports
The campus features athletic fields, a gymnasium, a swimming pool, and facilities supporting 14 varsity sports year-round. Plus, the university participates as the Salem Tigers in NCAA Division II sports like basketball, soccer, and water polo.

Cafeteria
You can get fresh food at the dining hall, which is located in the Randolph Campus Centre. You can also opt for various dining plans.
